chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khathʿamī, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and he said: It is as she had been, in accordance with what has passed regarding her previous children and what she has experienced. I said: Then if she had not given birth before? He said: Between forty and fifty.

key_terms.أَوْلَادِهَا: her children; referring to previous childbirths as a basis for ruling
key_terms.الْأَرْبَعِينَ: forty; the lower bound of the stated range
key_terms.الْخَمْسِينَ: fifty; the upper bound of the stated range
key_terms.تَلِدْ: to give birth; referring to whether she had prior childbirths
key_terms.جَرَّبَتْ: she experienced or tested; meaning her known prior pattern
key_terms.سَأَلْتُ: I asked; indicates a direct legal inquiry to the Imam عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: How is the maximum period of nifās determined if a woman has or has not given birth before?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh-based ruling concerning the determination of the period of nifās, referring first to a woman's prior experience in childbirth. If she has no previous childbirth history, the Imam عليه السلام states a range of between forty and fifty days.
